questions.question: A bag contains notes of Rs. 10, Rs. 20, and Rs 50 in the ratio of 1 : 3 : 5. If the total value of money in the bag is Rs. 1920. Find the number of Rs. 20 notes.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A bag contains notes of Rs. 10, Rs. 20, and Rs 50 in the ratio of 1 : 3 : 5

The total value of money in the bag is Rs. 1920

**Calculation:**

Let number of notes of Rs. 10, Rs. 20, and Rs 50 be 1x, 3x, and 5x respectively

And the total value of money in the bag is Rs. 1920

⇒ (10 × 1x) + (20 × 3x) + (50 × 5x) = 1920

⇒ 320x = 1920

⇒ x = 6

∴ The number of Rs. 20 notes = 3x

⇒ 3 × 6 = 18

questions.question: If Lalitha leaves home and drives to her school at a speed of 45 kmph, she reaches 5 minutes later than when she drives at 60kmph speed. Find the distance to her school (in km).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Lalitha leaves home and drives to her school at a speed of 45 kmph

She reaches 5 minutes later than when she drives at 60kmph speed

**Formula used:**

D × [(S₂ - S₁)/(S₂S₁)] = (T₂ - T₁)

**Calculation:**

Here, since reaches 5 minutes late, (T2 - T1) = 5 minutes = 5/60 hours

⇒ D × [(60 - 45)/(60 × 45)] = 5/60

⇒ D × (1/3) = 5

⇒ D = 15

∴ Distance = 15 km

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

Let, the distance be x km

When speed is 60 km/h, total time to cover the distance = x/60 hours

When speed is 45 km/h, total time to cover the distance = x/45 hours

time difference = 5 min = 5/60 = 1/12 hour

Accordingly,

x/60 + 1/12 = x/45

⇒ x/45 - x/60 = 1/12

⇒ (4x - 3x)/180 = 1/12

⇒ x = 180/12 = 15

**∴ The distance to her school is 15 km.**

questions.question: Four bells ring at 16, 24, 36, 42 minute intervals. If they ring together at 6.00 a.m. after how long would they next ring together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Four bells ring at 16, 24, 36, 42 minute intervals

They ring together at 6.00 a.m

**Concept:**

Next time when the bells ring together will be the LCM 

**Calculation:**

To find LCM (16, 24, 36, 42) use prime factorization method:

16 = 2⁴

24 = 2³ × 3

36 = 2² × 3²

42 = 2 × 3 × 7

LCM = 2⁴ × 3² × 7 = 1008

∴ After 1008 minutes the four bells would next ring together

questions.question: 'K' can do 3/4thof a work in 6 days and 'J' can do 2/5thof the same work in 4 days. How long (in days) will they take, if they together to finish the work?

'K' can do 3/4thof a work in 6 days 

 'J' can do 2/5thof the same work in 4 days

**Formula used:**

Number of days = Total work/1 day's work (Efficiency)

**Calculation:**

K can do the whole work alone in [(6 × 4)/3] days

⇒ K → 8 days

J can do the whole work alone in [(4 × 5)/2] days

⇒ J → 10 days

Total work = LCM (8, 10) = 40 unit

⇒ 1 day's work of K = 40/8 = 5 unit

⇒ 1 day's work of J = 40/10 = 4 unit

⇒ 1 day's work of (K + J) = 5 + 4 = 9 unit

∴ Number of days = 40/9

⇒ 4 (4)/(9) days

questions.question: What is the method of taxing wherein there is an increase in the tax rate as the taxable amount increases?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Progressive tax.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points:__****Progressive tax:**

 
• **A progressive tax** is a tax in which the tax rate increases as the taxable amount increases.
 
• That means the** low tax is imposed on low-income earners** compared to those with a higher income.
 
• **Excise duties, Octroi, and House tax **all are fixed but income tax is different for different earning people.

**Regressive tax:**

 
• A regressive tax is a type of tax that is** levied regardless of income, in which low and high-income earners pay the same amount.**
 
• This kind of tax is a **bigger burden on low-income earners** than on high-income earners.
 
• The indirect taxes are paid by everyone if anyone buys any product irrespective of financial conditions.
 
• Regressive tax and Indirect taxes both are levied on everyone.
 
• Some examples of indirect taxes include **sales tax, entertainment tax, excise duty, etc.​​**
